evidence_basis: Wave317 current_task and queue exact_read_paths contain no parcel-to-TOID or parcel geometry input
canonical repository code search returned no gas_emissions_2 TOID/UPRN parcel contract match

decision_reason: OS Open Linked Identifiers provides an authoritative UPRN-to-TopographicArea TOID relationship, but the canonical gas_emissions_2 parcel partition does not declare its identifier type and supplies neither parcel-to-TOID nor parcel geometry input. HMLR INSPIRE polygons do not document an authoritative UPRN/TOID key, so exact parcel binding cannot be promoted without a derived spatial guess.

source_evidence_manifest.relevant_excerpt: OS Open Linked Identifiers provides authoritative relationship between Unique Property Reference Numbers (UPRNs), Unique Street Reference Numbers (USRNs), Topographic Object Identifiers (TOIDs) and metadata. TopographicArea is limited to address and road features. Geometry is not included in OS Open Linked Identifiers.
The Open Linked Identifier data product is supplied in CSV format. Relationship BLPU_UPRN_TopographicArea_TOID_5 represents BLPU <-> TopographicArea.
OS Open UPRN attributes include UPRN, X_COORDINATE, Y_COORDINATE, LATITUDE and LONGITUDE. All records are provided as point geometry in the GeoPackage.

OS Open TOID provides a generalised location for features extracted from OS MasterMap products. TOID geometry always lies within the polygon and is supplied as a point suitable for labelling, not as the source polygon geometry.

INSPIRE data shows the indicative extent and position of registered freehold properties in England and Wales. Users can download polygons by local authority. Downloads are subject to OGL conditions of use.
